bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (local store), springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (search index), springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export), springboard/ui/src/vcard.rs (vCard read and write), springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs (groups), springboard/ui/src/contact_changes.rs (batched saves and change history); no SDK module
summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed single-valued fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Pure models now exist for vCard read and write, groups with subgroups, and batched saves with a change history, but the store does not use them and apps get no SDK contacts API, no permission model and no contacts-changed notification.

features.note: Store is a shell module. The Contacts app reaches it by crate path (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:20), not through springboard/sdk/src/. Apps have no fetch or save call.

features.apple: Accessing the contact store; NSContactsUsageDescription; contact access button and picker
features.note: No permission prompt or per-app grant. Any code in the shell reads the whole file.

Fixed fields: name, phone, email, notes, company, address, favorite, and three label indexes. No multi-value lists in the store (one phone, one email, one address), no birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs, images or nickname.

The store has fixed English label sets (mobile, home, work, other) indexed by number. The vCard model holds any number of labelled phones and emails with free lower-case labels, but the store does not use it. No localized label strings.
Every fetch loads all fields. No key list and no partial contacts. Search covers name, phone, email, notes, company and address.

The shell store rewrites the whole file atomically on each save and rejects invalid input, keeping the old file. The pure model applies a batch of add, update and delete operations all or nothing, validates each record and returns the identifiers given to the adds. The shell store does not call the model yet.

features.apple: CNContainer, CNGroup, CNMutableGroup, CNContainerTypeKey, CNSaveRequest group operations
features.note: Pure model of named groups in a tree with subgroups, contact members, recursive membership, cycle-free moves and subtree removal. No containers (accounts). Not persisted, not used by the store, and the Contacts app lists sidebar lists without group data behind them.

features.apple: CNChangeHistoryFetchRequest, CNChangeHistoryEvent family, CNChangeHistoryEventVisitor, Contacts changed notifications
features.note: Pure model: each applied change gets a sequence number, a token fetches later changes, and an old token reports Expired when the bounded history no longer reaches it. No group events, no notification to apps, and the shell store does not record history.

Display name falls back name, company, phone, email. Initials are computed. The vCard model falls back formatted name, given and family name, then organization. No locale-aware name order and no postal address formatter.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/vcard.rs (parse, Card::to_vcard); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs:33 (Item::from_contact builds a vCard card)
features.note: The model reads and writes vCard 3.0 text: unfolds and unescapes on read, escapes and folds to 75 bytes on write, keeps TYPE labels, and skips empty values and unknown properties. It does not read or write addresses, dates, photos or custom properties. Share still uses its own writer and has not moved to the model, and the Contacts app has no vCard import.
No contact display preferences such as sort order or name order.

features.apple: Spotlight-style indexing of contacts (no direct CNContact symbol)
features.note: Shell Search returns contacts from the store. Apps index their own content through the SDK quicksearch module, which the contact store does not use.

features.apple: Contact access button, Contact access picker (sample code)
features.note: No picker that lets an app receive one chosen contact without seeing the whole store.

Shell errors are std io errors with fixed text. The pure models return typed error enums (invalid operation index, unknown record, expired token, unknown group, cycle, name length, malformed vCard), but apps cannot reach them yet.
Notes are plain text with a 4000-character limit in the store, with no entitlement. The vCard model reads and writes NOTE text. No contact photo or thumbnail data.

gaps: No SDK contacts module: apps cannot fetch, search, create or save contacts (springboard/sdk/src/ has no contacts file).
No permission model for contact access (NSContactsUsageDescription equivalent, per-app grant, contact access picker).
Groups, batched saves, change history and vCard read or write exist only as pure models in springboard/ui/src; the contact store does not use them and apps cannot reach them.
No containers (accounts) behind groups, and no persisted group data.
Single-valued fields in the shell store: one phone, one email, one address. The vCard model holds several, but the store does not.
vCard addresses, dates, photos and custom properties are not read or written, and there is no vCard import in the Contacts app.
No key-based partial fetch; every read loads the whole store (cap 10,000 contacts, 8 MiB file).
